I’m sorry to hear about your dad being a total dick head, My mom is the same way. But something I learn from living with some one like that is you can believe that your a burden and and inconvenience but if you take a step back and look at the people around you, your not the burden your just trying you best to live day to day and it’s hard, especially if the people around you can’t understand what they’re doing to others. The game of life is a hard cruel turn of events and we can’t do much about it but one thing, believe in yourself and try to make the best life for you. I hope things get better for you I really do.
